queries.name: GetPendingRfcTerminalCascade
queries.lookup_rule: public transport resolves the one current pending proposal for exactly rfc_id. Internal repository helpers may load a known proposal_id, but proposal_id is not a second public lookup mode for this query.
queries.output: pending proposal identity, trigger RFC, revision, terminal status class/evidence/epoch, scope kind/fingerprint, exact RFC/WFM member counts and one bounded immutable captured-member page
queries.ordering: member_kind_ordinal ASC where RFC=0 and WFM=1, captured ordinal ASC, member immutable ID ASC

cursor.last_key_tuple: exact array [member_kind_ordinal:int 0|1, ordinal:int>=0, member_id:uuid] where member_id is rfc_id for RFC rows and task_id for WFM rows
cursor.comparison: lexicographic keyset greater-than over (member_kind_ordinal,ordinal,member_id) after the exact persisted proposal is resolved
cursor.filter_fingerprint_canonicalization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exact UTF-8 followed by lowercase SHA-256 hex
cursor.continuation_rule: null when no additional persisted captured member exists after the page; otherwise exact CursorV1 semantic body for the last returned member. Cursor reuse after pending-proposal replacement/revision/fingerprint change fails stale/invalid rather than paging a different proposal.

rules: executed/superseded history is not returned as executable pending authority
this query exposes persisted proposal evidence only and never recomputes or mutates scope
state.scope_fingerprint is read verbatim from the persisted proposal and is not reconstructed from the bounded member page
exact member counts are computed from persisted immutable membership, not inferred from the returned page length

queries.name: PreviewRfcTerminalCascade
queries.read_consistency: one LLD-01 stable ReadSnapshot; no writer UnitOfWork and no mutation
queries.output: persisted scope fingerprint/member count versus freshly recomputed current scope fingerprint/member count, exact stale reasons, provider-bound preview fingerprint, one bounded cross-domain impact page, warnings, execution readiness and—only when READY—the bounded RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 required by Execute
queries.current_scope_rule: Load current trigger RFC terminal projection inside the snapshot. If current terminal_epoch_id differs from persisted proposal epoch, current_scope_fingerprint=null, current_member_count=0 and stale_reasons includes TERMINAL_EPOCH_CHANGED. If epoch matches and current terminal class/evidence differ, recompute complete current RFC/WFM scope using the current accepted terminal binding and include TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_CHANGED. Any resulting SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 fingerprint mismatch includes RFC_OR_WFM_SCOPE_CHANGED.
queries.participant_rule: LLD-05 exposes the same applicable-WFM eligibility selector over ReadSnapshot for recomputation and separately previews Task/Objective impacts. LLD-09 previews Communication impacts. Both return RfcTerminalCascadeImpactProviderPageV1 semantics; provider INDETERMINATE makes impacts empty, continuation null, execution_ready=false and execution_review=null.
queries.local_ticket_impacts: one RFC_TERMINAL_SCOPE_MEMBER item per freshly recomputed RFC member when a current executable scope exists; ordering follows impact_kind then rfc_id and is independent from transport page size
queries.ordering: impact_domain_ordinal ASC where TICKETS=0,TASKS_OBJECTIVES=1,COMMUNICATIONS=2; impact_kind UTF-8 ASC; entity_id UTF-8 ASC

cursor.filter_fingerprint_canonicalization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exact UTF-8 followed by lowercase SHA-256 hex
cursor.continuation_rule: continuation is emitted only when all providers are READY and another exact impact item exists. Cursor reuse after proposal revision, scope, Task/Objective impact or Communication impact changes fails stale/invalid rather than splicing previews.

preview_fingerprint.ordering: stale_reasons in closed ordinal TERMINAL_EPOCH_CHANGED,TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_CHANGED,RFC_OR_WFM_SCOPE_CHANGED; provider summaries use fixed key names and no warning prose
preview_fingerprint.canonicalization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exact UTF-8 then lowercase SHA-256 hex

queries.execution_review_rule: execution_review is non-null only when execution_ready=true and is the exact closed RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 {preview_fingerprint,task_objective_exact_count,task_objective_provider_fingerprint,communication_exact_count,communication_provider_fingerprint} copied from the complete READY provider summaries; it contains no impact items/text and is not separately persisted as provider-owned state.
rules: full-scope comparison and provider fingerprints are computed server-side before transport paging and never trust client-provided members or impact rows
read-only preview performs no scope refresh, receipt, audit, deliberate-proof consumption or downstream mutation
execution_ready is true only when proposal remains pending, stale_reasons is empty and both cross-domain providers are READY; exactly then execution_review is emitted

current terminal Closed<->Cancelled correction in the same epoch is represented as TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_CHANGED and normally changes current_scope_fingerprint because terminal class/evidence are fingerprint inputs
INDETERMINATE participant preview fails closed and never returns a misleading partial cross-domain impact page

pagination: Both terminal-cascade surfaces use CURSOR_V1 keyset paging. Full-scope safety decisions use server-computed counts/fingerprints over indexed reads and never depend on an unbounded client payload.
